flavor.phonemic_palette: Lizardman (Kazhur, smooth-hiss regression): sh/s/z/ss prominent and drawn out, cold and even (not foul like the trog), suffixes -ssa/-isk/-aza; sustained, sibilant, articulate.

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore §4.2): Lawful venerates the 12 Lawful powers and names the 13 as demons; Chaotic venerates the 13 and names the 12 as tyrant-gods; Neutral venerates this culture's ancestral saints, invoking the great gods only situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Lizardman — wary tribal of the swamp; survival.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Lizardman are a Chaotic beastman race; aggression 0.6, organized as tribal. Their tongue is a regressed form (see name_bank 'lizardman'). Stripped record per gdd-culture-catalog §5.3.
